name: iitpsx-bench
description: Web bench for the CS2102 IITPSx assembler and emulator

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
scripts.setup: npm run tools && npm run install:all
